summary: A Yes vote establishes a 1.5% sales tax in the City of Weed, providing approximately $1,700,000 annually for general city services until repealed by voters.

tax.text: A Yes vote establishes a 1.5% local transactions and use tax, increasing the City sales tax rate to 9.00%.
tax.quote: If Measure K is approved, the rate would become 9.00%.

tax.text: A No vote rejects the measure and does not establish the additional 1.5% tax.
